title: videoClipSchema
responsibility: Validate modular video clip contracts and recorded video provenance

inputs.name: videoBindings.manifest
inputs.description: Finite clip, viewport and graph declarations whose references must be consistent.

inputs.name: videoBindings.context
inputs.description: Zod refinement context that receives diagnostics for invalid graph and clip bindings.

inputs.name: videoClipSchema.value
inputs.description: JSON declaration to validate against the versioned video manifest and reference rules.

outputs.name: videoBindings
outputs.description: No return value; invalid references add validation issues to the supplied context.

outputs.name: videoManifestBaseSchema
outputs.description: Strict version-one schema for video declaration fields before cross-reference checks.

outputs.name: videoManifestSchema
outputs.description: Version-one declaration schema with graph reachability and clip/checkpoint reference checks.

outputs.name: videoCaptureSchema
outputs.description: Version-one schema for clip provenance, timed assertions, recording facts and poster references.

outputs.name: videoClipSchema
outputs.description: Validated finite video declaration retaining its authored clips, graphs, viewports and playlists.

errors.name: ZodError
errors.description: The JSON declaration is malformed or has invalid graph, clip, viewport or checkpoint references.
